name: Ivy Hershon
bio:
Ivy Hershon is a remarkably skilled tattoo artist specializing in illustrative and newschool styles, ensuring each piece is a vibrant, unique expression of her clients' visions. Working out of Studio Artease in Verdun, Ivy's reputation for professionalism is reflected in her meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to creating a perfect piece of art on every canvas she works on. Her portfolio is a testament to her talent, and her clients leave not just with a tattoo, but with a true work of art.
